description: This subject of the Smart Data Models initiative defines shared data models for streetlights and the equipment that controls them, so that city platforms can exchange lighting data in a common form. It has five entity types: Streetlight, StreetlightControlCabinet, StreetlightGroup, StreetlightFeeder and StreetlightModel, each with a JSON schema, a specification translated into several languages, an interactive Swagger specification and examples in NGSI-v2 and NGSI-LD in key-value and normalised forms. The Streetlight model was at version 0.2.1 when read, with ten listed contributors to the subject; the last commit is of 31 October 2024. Coverage: a schema with no geographic limit. Access: free on GitHub and the smart-data-models GitHub Pages site. Licence: CC BY 4.0 in the Streetlight model folder. Caveats: this is a schema, not data; version numbers below 1 show the models are still changing. Simulation uses are a common structure for streetlight assets and states in public space digital twins built on FIWARE context brokers. Related records: the San Antonio smart streetlight pilot data and the Brick building metadata schema.
